svg.title: Windows and WSL boundary
svg.desc: Keep the dotfiles repository in the WSL ext4 filesystem, use WSLg for Linux GUI apps, and treat systemd and Tailscale as optional WSL services.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: Windows runs the desktop. WSL runs the Linux toolchain. The boundary is deliberate.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: WSLg renders Linux GUI apps next to Windows.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: /mnt/c is convenient for sharing, not for Git.
